notes.title: Dev Update #1 - Agust
notes.notes:
The month of August is marked by the first month of development of Out Of Jail, in addition to all the initial structuring of the game, mechanics and adaptation with the engine.

[h2]What's new[/h2]

[h3]Lobby[/h3]
Implementing full lobby system (still no match settings, just lobby settings). It is possible to create a public or private lobby, with or without a password, number of players and everything else.

[b]Creating a new lobby.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42830542/3dceadb104fc80bf7dba1f5d250d59fd6fbeebd5.png[/img]


[b]Lobby in the view of who created the lobby (with settings and start game options)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42830542/052bea301606bb29db6ea78e240a9d150db7400c.png[/img]

[h3]Basic multiplayer mechanics[/h3]
It is now possible to start a game from a lobby and have the basic movement mechanics reflected for everyone in the match.

[h3]And some other things...[/h3]
Several other minor things, such as the main menu.

[h2]What comes next?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Items (work in progress): Possibility of picking up an item on the map and using it.
[*] VOIP (work in progress): Directional VOIP (listen who is close)
[*] Inventory: Possibility of having more than one item with you, the initial idea is that you carry few items, because you will not have a backpack.
[*] Character: Creation of the 3D model of the character.
[/list]

[h2]Release[/h2]
No exact plans yet for a closed beta or early access release, maybe at the end of the first half of 2023.
